verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no public Graphite API, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404. The gt CLI and GT MCP are first-party programmatic surfaces, but they cover only stacking and stacked-PR creation, not the UI's AI reviews, Insights, merge queue, automations or chat. They are adjacent interfaces, not evidence of API parity with the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
